crossRefs.note: “Yahweh, the God of Israel, says, ‘Write all the words that I have spoken to you in a book.
For, behold, the days come,’ says Yahweh, ‘that I will reverse the captivity of my people Israel and Judah,’ says…
“Take a scroll of a book, and write in it all the words that I have spoken to you against Israel, and against Judah…
Then took Jeremiah another scroll, and gave it to Baruch the scribe, the son of Neriah, who wrote therein from the…
Yahweh said to me, “Take a large tablet, and write on it with a man’s pen, ‘For Maher Shalal Hash Baz’;
Now go, write it before them on a tablet, and inscribe it in a book, that it may be for the time to come forever and…
But you, Daniel, shut up the words, and seal the book, even to the time of the end. Many will run back and forth, and…
Yahweh answered me, “Write the vision, and make it plain on tablets, that he who runs may read it.
For the vision is yet for the appointed time, and it hurries toward the end, and won’t prove false. Though it takes…
saying, “What you see, write in a book and send to the seven assemblies: to Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira…
Write therefore the things which you have seen, and the things which are, and the things which will happen hereafter.

people.name: Babylon
people.line: Ancient Mesopotamian city, capital of Babylonian Empire, site of the Tower of Babel.

people.name: Jeremiah
people.line: Son of Hilkiah, the prophet during Judah's final days.

translations.web: Jeremiah wrote in a book all the evil that should come on Babylon, even all these words that are written concerning Babylon.
translations.bsb: Jeremiah had written on a single scroll about all the disaster that would come upon Babylon—all these words that had been written concerning Babylon.
translations.kjv: So Jeremiah wrote in a book all the evil that should come upon Babylon, even all these words that are written against Babylon.
translations.asv: And Jeremiah wrote in a book all the evil that should come upon Babylon, even all these words that are written concerning Babylon.
